name: 3 Billion Dreams for a Forgiveness Machine
source: A featureless doll is locked in an apartment, and must write stories that will always be rejected, and must eat feces out of instant-noodle containers despite having no mouth, all for the Forgiveness Machine.
translation: 一个毫无特色的娃娃被锁在公寓里，必须写出永远被拒绝的故事，必须无嘴吃泡面盒里的粪便，一切都是为了宽恕机。
